sources.title: Afghanistan Travel Advisory
sources.officialityEvidence: The live U.S. Department of State page, issued 2 April 2026, directly addresses U.S. citizens, ordinary passport validity and the current pre-travel Afghan visa requirement, including recognition risks for Republic-era mission visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: An Afghan visa is required to enter and exit Afghanistan. You must apply for a visa before you travel.

sources.title: Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Slovenia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Slovenian government country page, last changed 9 March 2026, directly states the Afghan visa and Vienna-embassy application route for Slovenian citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Slovenski državljani za vstop v Afganistan potrebujejo vizum, za katerega lahko zaprosijo na Veleposlaništvu Afganistana na Dunaju.

sources.title: Afghanistan entry and residence guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, Department of Consular Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Chinese MFA consular page distinguishes the diplomatic-passport waiver from the ordinary route, identifies Afghan Embassy issuance in China and includes a 15 May 2025 entry update for Chinese citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 阿富汗驻华使馆通常颁发一次入境、有效期内停留30天的签证。

policies.title: U.S. ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: Current U.S. State Department guidance requires U.S. citizens to obtain an Afghan visa before travel and warns that the de facto authorities may reject visas from Republic-era missions they do not recognize.
conditions: Applies to a U.S. citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit; U.S. citizens treated as Afghan nationals or travelling on an Afghan passport follow separate rules.
The visa must be obtained before travel from a consular authority accepted by the Afghan de facto authorities; some Republic-era mission visas may be refused.
The passport must remain valid for at least six months beyond arrival and have a blank page.
Security advice, purpose restrictions, registration, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: Slovenia’s current government country page requires Slovenian citizens to obtain an Afghan visa and identifies the Afghan Embassy in Vienna as the application mission.
conditions: Applies to a Slovenian citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit.
The visa application is made before travel through the Afghan Embassy in Vienna.
Mission recognition, document validity, purpose restrictions, security conditions, carrier checks and final admission must be confirmed before travel.

policies.title: Chinese ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: China’s current consular guidance identifies an advance Afghan Embassy visa for Chinese ordinary-passport visitors and separately limits the bilateral waiver to diplomatic passports.
conditions: Applies to a Chinese citizen using an ordinary passport; the cited bilateral visa waiver is limited to diplomatic passports.

The Afghan Embassy in China normally issues a single-entry visa permitting a stay of up to 30 days after the applicant supplies the required passport, identity, application and Afghan invitation documents.
A visa marked AIR ONLY permits entry and exit only through airports under the 15 May 2025 rule.
Passport validity, purpose permissions, mission recognition, registration, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
